convert_coco_model_to_cityscapes: run the script to convert a COCO pretrained detection model to Cityscapes format using --coco_model and --output flags
convert_coco_blobs_to_cityscape_blobs: convert COCO model blobs with 81 classes to Cityscapes blobs with 9 classes by reshaping and remapping weights
convert_coco_blob_to_cityscapes_blob: convert a single COCO blob to Cityscapes format by mapping class IDs and initializing unmapped classes with Gaussian noise
remove_momentum: remove momentum blobs from a model dictionary by deleting all keys ending with the _momentum suffix
load_and_convert_coco_model: load a COCO model file, remove momentum blobs, and convert all blobs to Cityscapes format in one step
